items.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!
items.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.

items.title: Keep Collecting and Mastering
items.body: There are all new Sprites to discover and collect! Extract and equip them for game-changing Sprite Powers, level them up, and keep growing the Collection in Override. Sprites will now appear in Ranked too, with abilities disabled to maintain even competition.

items.title: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style
items.body: Gifting the Override Battle Pass unlocks the Peril Peak Mali Style and matching accessories for both the gifter and the friend receiving it!

items.title: New Loot Hacks and Fresh Sprites
items.body: More weapons have arrived via Loot Hacks! Spend Sprite Dust on a Loot Hack to customize what drops from Chests, shaking up matches with bonus items that can't be found anywhere else. Plus, try the new Prop Hunt Override and chase X-Ray, Onigiri, and more Sprites.

items.title: KINGDOM HEARTS - September 17
items.body: On September 17, answer the call of the Light!
